preconditions.name: capacity::env_local_view_clears_floor
preconditions.description: LocalViewGreedyPolicy reading the same 5x5 resource_field_view forages above the 1.0 competence floor on THIS family's env -- the positive control that the env is solvable from the local view (same statistic the verdict routes on). Below-floor means the substrate/env is not ready, NOT that the baseline mechanism failed.
preconditions.control: local_view_greedy foraging_competence on the family's control env vs the 1.0 floor

preconditions.name: capacity::scalar_control_competent
preconditions.description: THE LOAD-BEARING NON-DEGENERACY GUARD. The family's SCALAR control must be competent -- mean late_competence across seeds clears the 1.0 floor -- so there is a control LEVEL for the treatment to be below. A control at floor cannot exhibit a treatment-below-control inversion, so the family self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a reversal verdict.
preconditions.control: scalar control arm mean late_competence vs the 1.0 floor

preconditions.name: capacity::scalar_inversion_reproduces
preconditions.description: The destructive treatment-below-control inversion must REPRODUCE on this build under the scalar critic: scalar control mean late_competence beats scalar treatment by >= INVERSION_MARGIN. Without a reproduced inversion there is nothing for the informative baseline to reverse, so the family is excluded (guards against substrate drift having already erased the phenomenon).
preconditions.control: scalar (control - treatment) mean late_competence vs INVERSION_MARGIN

preconditions.name: capacity::trajectory_readings
preconditions.description: The DV is a TRAJECTORY, so the family's worst cell must carry at least two probe readings -- one reading has no shape and cannot support a late-competence mean.
preconditions.control: worst-cell number of mid-training competence probe readings in the family

interpretation.preconditions_scope_note: interpretation.preconditions carries the GREEN arm(s) only (capacity, approach). The RED arm(s) (metabolic) are carried in full at top level under per_arm_gate.red, and their criteria are marked load_bearing:false + criteria_non_degenerate:false. The indexer's _compute_adjudication reads interpretation.preconditions FLAT and ARM-BLIND and returns precondition_unmet for the WHOLE RUN on the first unmet entry, so including a scored-out arm's failure here would re-vacate the green arm at adjudication time.

criteria.name: C_two_of_three_families_reverse_or_flatten
criteria.description: In >= 2 of the 3 SCORABLE families, the treatment-below-control inversion REVERSES OR FLATTENS under the distributional (informative) critic on a strict majority of seeds -- late_competence, paired within seed.

criteria.name: C_capacity_reverses_or_flattens
criteria.description: family 'capacity' (actor_critic_hidden 128->256 + budget 3x->5x (make_on_config; 769 ON arm)) reverses/flattens on a strict majority of seeds

criteria.name: C_approach_reverses_or_flattens
criteria.description: family 'approach' (non-extinguishing appetitive-approach drive (approach_coef=1.0; 781 treat)) reverses/flattens on a strict majority of seeds

criteria.name: C_metabolic_reverses_or_flattens

interpretation_grid.label: baseline_informativeness_reverses_iatrogenesis
interpretation_grid.condition: >= 2 of 3 scorable families reverse or flatten under the distributional critic
interpretation_grid.reading: The uninformative value baseline WAS the source of the destructiveness: making the baseline informative changes the sign/flattens the treatment-below-control inversion across a majority of independent interventions. Supports MECH-475.

interpretation_grid.label: iatrogenesis_persists_under_informative_baseline
interpretation_grid.reading: Treatments still land below their own controls with an informative baseline. The destructiveness is NOT the baseline's doing -> MECH-475 is WITHDRAWN (the whole content is the causal attribution; it does not degrade to a weaker version). Weakens MECH-475.

interpretation_grid.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation_grid.condition: fewer than 2 families are scorable: an env anchor is sub-floor, the scalar control is not competent, the scalar inversion did not reproduce, or the trajectory has no shape
interpretation_grid.reading: A family whose control did not clear the readiness anchors (or whose destructive inversion did not reproduce on this build) CANNOT exhibit a reversal. UNINFORMATIVE about the claim; requeue. NEVER a reversal or a weakens verdict.

evidence_direction_note: MECH-475's own decisive, pre-registered reversal test (what_would_answer (a)): substituting a distributional critic for the scalar one, the destructive treatment-below-control inversion got 3.4x WORSE, not better, on all 6 scorable seeds, every gate green. Claim falsified on its own most decisive, self-nominated prediction -- WITHDRAWN, not narrowed.
